sub: Keep every version of every object.

Overview.p: Versioning keeps every version of every object in a bucket. A delete adds a delete marker, so you can restore earlier versions.
An undo button for files: every save is kept.
A finance team enables versioning so an overwritten report can be restored.

items: Each upload gets a new version ID
A delete adds a delete marker
